Name: Lakeside Farm
Author: CRABSUIT
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=6]Lakeside Farm[/size]
[/font][i][size=3][color=#f4f4f4] A standalone map which allows lake fish to be caught, or land expansion for the riverland farm.[/color]

[color=#00ff00]This picture is every tile filled on a riverland farm. This mod can be used to expand the land of preexisting riverland farms.[/color]
[color=#00ff00]____________________________________________________________________________________________________________[/color]
[/size][/i][img]http://i.imgur.com/Risx3DX.jpg[/img]
[color=#ffff00][b][size=5]
Why Should I download this?[/size]

[size=3]Riverland:[/size]
[/b][/color][list]
[*][color=#ffff00]You need more space to expand your riverland farm.[/color]
[*][color=#ffff00]It can be installed over a current riverland farm with no clipping issues or loss of items/progress.[/color]
[/list][color=#ffff00][size=3][b]
Normal:[/b][/size]
[/color][list]
[*][color=#ffff00]You want to catch lake fish next to your house.[/color]
[*][color=#ffff00]You're a cool person[/color]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Install:
[/size][/b] 1. Download "Farm_Fishing.xnb" from the files tab.
2. Extract the "Content" folder into your "Stardew Valley\" folder.
3. Replace current files if prompted.

[size=3][b]Uninstall:[/b][/size]
1. Extract "Farm_Fishing.xnb" from the "(UNINSTALL)" folder into your "Stardew Valley\Content\Maps\" folder.
** NOTE ** If you reinstall the standard map any items built in the rivers will be stuck! 


[size=3]Updates:[/size]
v1 - Fixed shading issues with a completed greenhouse/Fixed a dark tile east of the southern path.
v2 - Adjusted the land beside the greenhouse/cave to allow for imports of existing riverland farms.
v3 - Placed an item on every tile and made the riverland map 100% compatible with importing riverland farms. Also added fishing to the north.
v3n - Added a normal map replacement which allows for lake fish to be caught.
v4 - Removed two random bushes east of the greenhouse.
v5 - Fixed an issue with bush discoloration in both versions.
